description: Unit test script for sales pipeline analytics report in ERPNext CRM module, including setup functions for test data.

classes.name: TestSalesPipelineAnalytics
classes.description: Unit test class for sales pipeline analytics report, testing various filter scenarios.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Sets up test data by deleting existing opportunities and creating company, customer, and opportunity records.

methods.name: test_sales_pipeline_analytics
methods.description: Main test method executing multiple filter-based report checks.

methods.name: check_for_monthly_and_number
methods.description: Verifies report output for monthly range grouped by owner and sales stage with number-based data.

methods.name: check_for_monthly_and_amount
methods.description: Verifies report output for monthly range grouped by owner and sales stage with amount-based data.

methods.name: check_for_quarterly_and_number
methods.description: Verifies report output for quarterly range grouped by owner and sales stage with number-based data.

methods.name: check_for_quarterly_and_amount
methods.description: Verifies report output for quarterly range grouped by owner and sales stage with amount-based data.

methods.name: check_for_all_filters
methods.description: Verifies report output with all filters applied, including date range and opportunity source.

methods.name: create_company
methods.description: Creates a 'Company' record named 'Best Test' if it does not exist.

methods.name: create_customer
methods.description: Creates a 'Customer' record named '_Test NC' if it does not exist.

methods.name: create_opportunity
methods.description: Creates an 'Opportunity' linked to '_Test NC' with specific details if it does not exist.
